result.title: Wet-Biased Data Pipelines Mislead the Training and Evaluation of Generative Precipitation Nowcasting
result.comment: 63 pages, 7 figures and 3 tables in the main text, 11 supplementary figures and 9 supplementary tables. This work has been submitted to npj Climate and Atmospheric Science
result.summary: Generative models for precipitation nowcasting are trained and evaluated predominantly on wet-biased datasets, which over-represent precipitation events to emphasize rare extremes. Selecting test cases based on target observations is known to favor forecasts that match the selected distribution rather than the intended deployment distribution. We show analytically how this target-dependent sampling also shifts the conditional distribution learned by generative models. When training and test sampling match, even an ideal model learns precisely the distribution favored by evaluation, allowing the evaluation bias to conceal the training bias. Using a fixed satellite-to-radar diffusion model, we demonstrate that target-dependent test sampling can reverse the calibration assessment. The model appears under-predictive on a wet-biased test set but over-predictive on a deployment-representative test set. This result is replicated outside the model's training domain after a seven-year gap. Utilizing classifier-free guidance as an example, we demonstrate how the contradictory calibration assessment can misdirect downstream model development.

AI.brief_summary: 论文分析降水临近预报中普遍存在的湿偏数据管线：基于目标观测的采样不仅偏向极端事件，还会改变生成模型学到的条件分布，使评测偏差掩盖训练偏差；作者用固定的卫星到雷达扩散模型证明，目标依赖的测试采样会让校准结论反转（湿偏测试集上偏低估、部署代表性测试集上偏高估），且七年后的域外数据仍可复现，并借 classifier-free guidance 说明这种矛盾评估会误导下游开发。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「目标依赖采样使训练与评测偏差互相掩盖、结论可被反转」的机制分析，可能为 LVR 中基准筛选、分布偏移下 latent 使用与校准评估的可靠性提供可供核查的方法论类比，但与视觉推理本身无直接关联。
